commit_title: Add enable toggle for style mappings
commit_message: Introduce an enable/disable switch for each style mapping in the Style side menu, greying out and disabling inputs when a mapping is turned off. Hooked up saturation setters/rendering (setSaturation and Saturation block) in the UI. Update PlotlyHelpers to respect mapping.enabled and use sensible defaults when a mapping is disabled for hue, saturation, lightness, shape and size so visual output falls back correctly.
